The [[Quockra system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Quockra-4]].
